vulnerable_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

router = APIRouter(prefix="/dev/tenants")

@router.post("/{tenant_slug}/reload-extensions")
async def trigger_extension_reload(
    tenant_slug: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    extension_manager: TenantExtensionManager = Depends(get_extension_manager)
):
    tenant = await extension_manager.find_tenant(slug=tenant_slug)
    if not tenant:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Tenant environment not found")

    reload_summary = await extension_manager.reload_tenant_modules(tenant_id=tenant.id)
    return {
        "tenant": tenant_slug,
        "status": "reloaded",
        "loaded_modules": reload_summary.module_names,
        "env_overrides": reload_summary.active_config
    }
diagnosis: The live-reload extension route reloads modules and returns loaded configuration dictionaries for tenant_slug. It does not verify that current_user belongs to tenant_slug. Any user can trigger extension reloads on target companies, disrupting running requests and receiving response payloads containing active module configurations and environment variables of the victim tenant.
